experiment_name: Phase 7 Oracle Routing and Fixed-Best Selection

verdict.description: Oracle routing improves both accuracy (+23.5%) and compute efficiency (-54.4% FLOPs) compared with the strongest fixed architecture (Fixed Attention V2).
verdict.justification: The central research question is supported: selecting the specialized expert by construction produces a definitive performance-compute Pareto advance over the best fixed architecture. Phase 8 learned routing is now scientifically warranted.
